description: Utentes com Comportamentos Aditivos e Dependências is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ICAD. Monitorização do movimento clínico de utentes com comportamentos aditivos e dependências. Utentes Novos: Utentes inscritos com comportamentos aditivos e dependências que recorreram pela primeira vez às estruturas de ambulatório da rede pública de tratamento (1ºs pedidos de tratamento). Coverage: ICAD. The publisher named on the listing is ICAD. Its keywords include dependencias, comportamentos-aditivos, transparencia-sns-gov-pt, saude-dos-portugueses, substancias. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
